# Endpoints

Every address below is the **host** surface: what you type on your own machine.
In-network traffic between containers does not use any of it — see each Module's
`x-endpoints:` description. Values are the defaults `.env.example` ships.

To change one: edit the `${VAR:-default}` in the owning Module's compose file **and**
the declaration in `.env.example` — `pixi run lint-endpoints` pins those two to each other and
fails while they disagree — then run `pixi run endpoints` and commit this file. Your own
`.env` overrides the value at runtime and is what `pixi run urls` prints, scoped to
the Selection you are running.

## Application variables

The names an application's own SDK reads. Each is owned by exactly one Module and
reaches exactly one of that Module's endpoints, which is what tells `REDIS_URL`,
`CELERY_BROKER_URL` and `CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND` apart.

| Variable | Module | Endpoint | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | `postgres` | `POSTGRES_PORT` | `postgresql://devinfra:devinfra@localhost:5432/devinfra` | SQLAlchemy and psycopg connection DSN. |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis` | `REDIS_PORT` | `redis://:devinfra@localhost:6379/0` | Application cache — logical database 0. |
| `CELERY_BROKER_URL` | `redis` | `REDIS_PORT` | `redis://:devinfra@localhost:6379/1` | Celery broker — logical database 1. |
| `CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND` | `redis` | `REDIS_PORT` | `redis://:devinfra@localhost:6379/2` | Celery result backend — logical database 2. |
| `OIDC_ISSUER` | `keycloak` | `KEYCLOAK_PORT` | `http://localhost:8080/realms/devinfra` | OIDC issuer; append /.well-known/openid-configuration for discovery. |
| `OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL` | `keycloak` | `KEYCLOAK_PORT` | `http://localhost:8080/realms/devinfra/.well-known/openid-configuration` | Discovery document an OIDC client fetches to configure itself. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | `keycloak` | `KEYCLOAK_PORT` | `devinfra-api` | The confidential client the realm import creates. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | `keycloak` | `KEYCLOAK_PORT` | `devinfra-local-secret` | Secret the realm import wires into the devinfra-api client. |
| `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL` | `minio` | `MINIO_API_PORT` | `http://localhost:9100` | S3 API endpoint every AWS SDK reads. |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | `minio` | `MINIO_API_PORT` | `devinfra` | S3 access key. |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | `minio` | `MINIO_API_PORT` | `devinfra123` | S3 secret key. |
| `SMTP_HOST` | `mailpit` | `MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT` | `localhost` | SMTP host; Mailpit accepts any credentials and delivers nothing onward. |
| `SMTP_PORT` | `mailpit` | `MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT` | `1025` | SMTP port. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | `otel-collector` | `OTEL_HTTP_PORT` | `http://localhost:4318` | OTLP/HTTP ingest for traces, logs and metrics. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` | `otel-collector` | `OTEL_HTTP_PORT` | `http/protobuf` | Wire protocol that endpoint expects; grpc needs OTEL_GRPC_PORT instead. |

## Service endpoints

### flower

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FLOWER_PORT` | `http://localhost:5555` | Flower UI and REST API over the Celery broker. |

### grafana

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GRAFANA_PORT` | `http://localhost:3000` | Grafana UI and HTTP API over Prometheus, Loki and Tempo. |

### keycloak

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEYCLOAK_PORT` | `http://localhost:8080` | OIDC issuer, admin console at /admin, discovery at /realms/&lt;realm&gt;/.well-known/openid-configuration. |
| `KEYCLOAK_MGMT_PORT` | `http://localhost:9000` | Management port — /health/ready and /metrics. |

### loki

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `LOKI_PORT` | `http://localhost:3100` | Loki HTTP API — /ready, /loki/api/v1/*, and the /otlp ingest path. |

### mailpit

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT` | `smtp://localhost:1025` | SMTP sink — accepts any credentials, stores every message. |
| `MAILPIT_UI_PORT` | `http://localhost:8025` | Mailpit web UI and REST API (/api/v1/messages), plus /readyz. |

### minio

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MINIO_API_PORT` | `http://localhost:9100` | S3 API endpoint. In-network the same service answers at http://minio:9000. |
| `MINIO_CONSOLE_PORT` | `http://localhost:9101` | Object-storage web console. |

### otel-collector

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OTEL_GRPC_PORT` | `grpc://localhost:4317` | OTLP/gRPC ingest for traces, logs and metrics. |
| `OTEL_HTTP_PORT` | `http://localhost:4318` | OTLP/HTTP ingest — /v1/traces, /v1/logs, /v1/metrics. |

### pgadmin

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PGADMIN_PORT` | `http://localhost:5050` | pgAdmin web UI, with the stack's Postgres pre-registered. |

### postgres

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | `postgresql://devinfra@localhost:5432/devinfra` | PostgreSQL wire protocol. In-network the same server answers at postgres:5432. |

### prometheus

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROMETHEUS_PORT` | `http://localhost:9090` | Prometheus UI and HTTP API — /-/healthy, /api/v1/*, /targets. |

### redis

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `REDIS_PORT` | `redis://:devinfra@localhost:6379` | Redis wire protocol — db 0 cache, db 1 Celery broker, db 2 Celery backend. |

### redisinsight

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `REDISINSIGHT_PORT` | `http://localhost:5540` | RedisInsight web UI, with the stack's Redis auto-added on first start. |

### tempo

| Variable | URL | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TEMPO_PORT` | `http://localhost:3200` | Tempo HTTP API — /ready, /api/traces/&lt;id&gt;, and OTLP ingest. |
